question: Should OpenClaw permanently expose `agents.run`, `phase`, and `log` as the QuickJS Code Mode Swarm API, with its replay and persistence contract?
rationale: This is a new public Code Mode capability with persisted replay metadata and gateway session-event implications; code review cannot choose the long-term API contract alone.

options.title: Sponsor the current API direction
options.body: Keep the opt-in QuickJS surface, require the protocol-field repair, compatibility coverage, and live restart-resume proof before merge.

options.title: Narrow the first release
options.body: Land only the collector launch/wait path and defer progress-note projection until its session-event contract is designed separately.

options.title: Pause for API design
options.body: Hold the PR until maintainers define the stable guest and session-event contract for Swarm orchestration.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the current API direction
recommendation.body: Keep the opt-in QuickJS surface, require the protocol-field repair, compatibility coverage, and live restart-resume proof before merge.
